summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle
details: @onereach/si-step-chooser@0.4.4 is published as a Vue step-chooser UI component (module: lib/component.js) but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook that runs an alien-runtime dropper. package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (identifiers like _0x...) and, at install time, downloads a platform-specific Bun 1.3.13 binary zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the Bun executable to a tempdir, chmods it 0755, and execFileSync's it against a sibling file math_init.js located in the package directory. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header) obfuscated with a custom string-array rotation (WV8StW shift routine) and a large charmap literal decoded at runtime by hc1jfK9. The filename 'math_init.js' has no relationship to the advertised Vue component purpose. The net effect is that npm install of this package fetches a second runtime and executes opaque author-controlled bytes on the installer's machine, bypassing Node-based inspection. The behavior is inconsistent with the package's declared purpose, and the payload's contents cannot be inspected without executing them under Bun.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
